pick.name: Toggl Track
pick.what: Cloud time tracker with timers, calendar integrations and reports
pick.why: Best polished timesheets and client reports for billable work
pick.free_limits: Free: up to 3 users, timers, calendar integration, personal reports; Starter ~$9/user/mo

best_free.name: Super Productivity
best_free.what: Open-source daily planner with pomodoro, time tracking and issue import
best_free.why: Free, offline-capable, MIT; imports issues into today's plan
best_free.install: brew install --cask super-productivity | Microsoft Store | Flathub/Snap | App Store | Google Play/F-Droid

alts.name: ActivityWatch
alts.what: Automatic local tracker of apps and sites used
alts.why: Zero-effort passive tracking; data stays local

alts.name: Motion
alts.why: Full auto-planning of tasks and meetings
alts.free_limits: Free trial; Pro AI $19/seat/mo, Business AI $29 (annual saves 33%)

candidates.name: ActivityWatch
candidates.verdict: Passive audit of where time went

candidates.name: WakaTime
candidates.verdict: Coding time only; AI stats paid

decision: Toggl Track is the best if time is billed to clients or you want shareable reports. Super Productivity is the better free all-in-one planner. Use ActivityWatch occasionally to audit a week.

verify.note: Verified: Free up to 3 users; Starter $9 annual / $12 monthly; Premium $16 / $24.
